title: Blocker Report
description: Structured documentation of a workflow blocker, including classification, impacted scope, what can continue, and a complete resume plan. Every blocker must include enough context to resume without re-reading prior session history.

run_id.description: Cache run ID during which this blocker was encountered

classification.description: Blocker type from the B1-B9 taxonomy: B1=needs user input, B2=missing local context, B3=missing guide, B4=missing source, B5=tool failure, B6=export failure, B7=schema conflict, B8=canon conflict, B9=output validation failed

description.description: Specific description of what is blocked and exactly why — must be specific enough for the user to understand without reading prior context

impacted_scope.description: Workflow stages, outputs, or sections that cannot proceed until this blocker is resolved

unimpacted_scope.description: Work that can continue in parallel despite this blocker — explicitly stated to enable partial progress

partial_outputs.description: Outputs that were produced before or despite the blocker — file paths or artifact IDs

blocked_on.description: Exact description of what must be provided or resolved to unblock — specific and unambiguous

to_resume.description: Command or action to run when the blocker is resolved (e.g. '/draft-section section_id=S3 run_id=abc123')

when_unblocked.description: Description of what will happen when the blocker is resolved — what will be produced and in what order

already_complete.description: Work that is already complete and does not need to be redone when resuming

created_by.description: Agent ID that identified and reported this blocker

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the blocker was recorded
